herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.80: To remove an item, right-click with an empty hand. Items will add back to player inventory, starting with the most recent.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.ee:
When the Basin has dried, Salt will appear.

You can automate collection with a hopper underneath the basin.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.6c: Pantry Jars will only hold items, not blocks.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.07: There are 3 styles of dinner plates:
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.b1: After some time, the wheel will change to an Aged wheel. Open the block interface once more, to retrieve the aged wheel.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.36: The Cheese Shelf allows Hoppers to insert raw wheels into the shelf, and Hopper output to extract aged wheels from it.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.7b: The Churn will animate and play sounds. When it's finished, it will drop a stick of Butter. This process can be automated with a Dispenser.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.6a:
A Cake, Pie, or Cheesecake placed on a Cake Stand will yield its normal amount of servings.

Note: Savory Pies can also be placed on a Cake Stand.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.94: Muffins, Cupcakes, Cookies, or Rolls can all be placed on a Pastry Stand.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.a0: The Empty Soup Pot can be placed and picked back up with an empty hand.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.15: When the Soup Pot is heated, use a bowl on it to retrieve soup.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.e6: Note: ONLY heated pots will allow a bowl to be used on them to get soup. Each pot will yield 8 bowls of soup.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.7e: The Empty Baking Pan can be placed and picked back up with an empty hand.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.ad:
The Baked Pan Meal is a placeable block. To 'serve' a Pan Meal, use a plate on it. Each pan yields 8 servings.

Pan Meal Recipes are discovered when a player obtains their main ingredient or meat.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.0a: Or, you can eat the food while holding the plate, and it will leave the empty plate behind, when finished.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.5a: Use a Pitcher on a glass cup to 'pour' a drink. Each pitcher can pour up to 4 drinks, and will leave behind an empty Glass Pitcher in the inventory.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.3b: Picking up a full cup will give an item that can be drank, and will leave behind the empty cup in the inventory, once used.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.8c:
Once you have your supplies ready, you will need to decide on what cheese to make.

There are 8 total types of cheeses, and each uses a unique mixture of milks to create.

Milk mixtures for Cheese recipes are as follows:
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.dc:
Soft Cheeses:

- Caravane: Camel Milk
- Chevre: Goat Milk
- Feta: Camel Milk, Goat Milk
- Ricotta: Camel Milk, Sheep Milk
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.8f: Make sure your Caluldron is heated below, and add your Milk to the Cauldron. For a mix of Milk types, add one, then quickly add the other.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.dc: When Rennet is added, you will see the mixture in the cauldron immediately change.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.3d: This looks like a yellow liquid with white bits that rise to the surface, as seen here in the photo. Bubbles will also be visible.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.91:
The Salt will combine with the Whey, and will solidify the cheese into a Cheese Wheel.

Your Cauldron should be empty after receiving the Cheese Wheel.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.c1: Place it down, and click on it to receive a wedge of Cheese.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.41: Add the Raw Wheel to a Cheese Shelf so that it can age. You will be able to see it change on the shelf, when it is aged.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.9f:
Each wheel will yield 4 Wedges of Cheese.

Special note: a cheese wheel CANNOT be picked up once it has been placed.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.d9: If Milk has cooked into Cream, extraction of the Cream Bucket can also be automated.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.c5:
Crops can be found in village farms, and seeds can be found in chests throughout the Overworld.

Seeds can also be created by crafting from produce. In a Crafting Table, one crop will yield one seed.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.cf:
Breaking either the top or bottom of these will break the entire crop, dropping its produce and seeds, if it is mature.

Only one seed is required to plant a tall crop, and they must be replanted.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.8f:
Like Cave Vines, they can be bonemealed.

Grapes can be found growing on trellises in villages, or in Overworld chests.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.96:
For Camel Milk, shift-click the bucket on a Camel.

Note: This may open the Camel's inventory or mount you on the Camel, but you will still get the Milk.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.2e:
Add any kind of milk, and it will eventually change into cream.

Use a bucket to remove the cream from the Cauldron.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.1e:
Butter is created by using a bucket of Cream on a Butter Churn.

Butter will appear when the Churn has finished churning.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.45: Minecraft Bread can also be crafted into slices:
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.4c:
Cakes, Cheesecakes, Pies, and Plum Pudding are all placeable blocks, and clicking on them with an open hand will give you a "slice" of that dessert.

All but the Plum Pudding will yield 8 Slices; the Plum Pudding is much smaller, so it yields 4 slices.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.7b: Dessert recipe discovery items are listed on the dessert's page.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.07: In the Pantry Update, Fresh herbs can be chopped or ground, then stored in Spice Jars for use in recipes.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.f4:
Thistle is two blocks tall, with purple/pink blooms.

It can be bonemealed and farmed the same way as tall flowers.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.f9:
To get Cinnamon, strip the bark by right-clicking the tree with an axe.

If the bark has matured, it will yield some Cinnamon.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.27: The 'Pantry Update', which adds new blocks, items, and food, was released in early February of 2026.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.5e:
Add it to a cauldron IMMEDIATELY after milk has been added.

Waiting too long to add Rennet will cause the Milk to turn into Cream.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.97: Salt is used in cheese-making, to finalize the process, and is also used in many of the food recipes in Herbs and Harvest.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.3d:
Onions and Garlic can be made into "Minced" variants, and Cinnamon and Ginger can be crafted into "Ground" versions.

These herbs and spices, along with Salt and Sugar, can be stored in the little Spice Jars.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.39:
I hope you enjoy this addition to my catalog of mods.

Much love,
~ Mama Michelle
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.a3:
The leaves of Fruit Trees continuously grow fruit, and can be bonemealed for quicker production.

Fruit Tree Saplings can be found in Overworld chests, and can also be potted.
herbsandharvest.guide_book.lanmc.page.39: Use the Table of Contents to navigate between chapters. Some chapters have sub-sections, and clicking a chapter title will return you to the chapter's main page.
